# CRYPTO SHOTS

[Crypto Shots](https://crypto-shots.com) had a huge year of development. A **massive wave of bug fixes, tweaks, and gameplay improvements** was shipped across the entire PvP Shooter experience.
**Four new game modes** were introduced: **Elimination**, **Covert Point**, **Kill Confirmed**, and **Gun Race**, alongside better onboarding with **Web2 login**, a balanced **life boost for struggling players**, a stronger **anti-cheat detection system**, and the release of the **PC build**.

Competitive play was expanded with **daily themed tournaments**, a **fairer Tournament Rewards System**, and **full match customization** — letting streamers and hosts control formats like **shields on/off**, **life recharge on/off**, **healthshot-only modes**, and much more.
**UI/UX improvements** were delivered in key areas like the **Lobby**, **Match Details**, and **Scoreboards** — with more upgrades coming in the future.

Beyond the PvP shooter, the Crypto Shots ecosystem continued to grow: ongoing development of a new game mode for **PvE**, improving the **NFT Marketplace** (**stability, security, UX**), shipping updates for **Crypto Chess** and the **Karina tipping bot**, releasing **automated earning reports** as **open-source**, and making cross-chain integrations easier — with the **ImmutableX integration** **now live**. Efforts also went into **infrastructure**, **DePIN adoption**, and the adoption of **agentic AI workflows** to speed up development.

On the growth side, Crypto Shots represented Hive through initiatives like **NFtopia**, the **SPS Burnathon Marathon**, and a new **partnership with Splinterlands** and the **SPS DAO** to onboard players from defunct web3 games onto Hive.
Thank you to our community for the support — **the next two years are going to be fire!** 😎
